description: Gemma 4 31B dense via Ollama: best Gemma 4 for quality, but slower than gemma4:26b on this machine.
notes: NOT INSTALLED: pull with `ollama pull gemma4:31b`. Download 19-20GB (30.7B dense, Q4_K_M default tag), needs ~24GB RAM plus KV cache; fits the 48GB M4 Max. Library context 256K; limit set to 131072 because Ollama sizes context from VRAM (assumes OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH raised). Gemma 4 model card: LiveCodeBench v6 80.0% (31B) vs 77.1% (26B-A4B), Codeforces ELO 2150 vs 1718; gemma4:26b is carded at 5.0 so 31b = 5.6. Q4 quantization already accounted for. Latency estimated for M4 Max 48GB by scaling measured gemma4:26b (78 tok/s, ~4B active) by active-weight bytes; not measured. Thinking is on by default: pass think=false for fast answers. Page: https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/core/model_card_4. Page checked 2026-10-25.
